It’s been interesting seeing the development of Zoodiac strategies over the last few weeks. They debuted in YCS Seattle, and were evenly split between pure and Kaiju versions of the Deck. Two weeks later,

was released and YCS Atlanta happened. There we started to see more pure versions of the Deck, but also a ton of Kaiju and some Invoked versions of the Deck. and a bunch of Kaiju monsters, when they could fill in their Decks with more support for their Zoodiac cards or answers to opposing Zoodiacs. However, we are still seeing many Kaiju in Side Decks for when those situations arise.

Who will be crowned the newest Ultimate Duelist? It’s time to find out at the Ultimate Duelist Series Invitational – Winter 2017, Las Vegas!!

We’re at the Alexis Park Resort, in always exciting Las Vegas! There’s a lot of gaming going on this weekend, from blackjack to basketball, but the real action is right here at the Ultimate Duelist Series Invitational! With 271 Duelists entered, we’ll have nine rounds of Swiss play today, and four more tomorrow before we make the cut to the Top 16.

As you can guess from the name, this is an invitation only event. You’ve got to earn Ultimate Duelist Series points throughout the Dueling season to qualify for this tournament, by playing in or judging tournaments. 100 points are needed to enter – for reference, first place of YCS Atlanta got 30 points. Thus, you’ll need to enter a lot of Regional Qualifiers, YCS tournaments, and more if you want a shot at the title of Ultimate Duelist!

Only first place gets to walk away with the title belt after this weekend, but everybody should be able to get a taste of what it’s like to be the Ultimate Duelist. Here are a few Duelists taking the chance to bask in the glory of “Ultimateness!”

As we near the end of the first day of the Ultimate Duelist Series Winter Invitational, Zoodiac have shown they are clearly the strategy to beat. Even though Zoodiacs have been dominant for a while, we had been seeing a lot of variation like Kaiju and Invoked Zoodiac strategies. This tournament is different, with almost entirely pure Zoodiac Decks taking the top Decks.
